result.summary: The page is largely intact and functional. The only notable issues are minor cosmetic and copy-clarity problems in the green promo banner; the partially visible carousel items and bottom-cut card are expected scroll behaviors and are not defects.

issues.description: The promotional banner's decorative overlapping circles are visible as harsh, hard-edged shapes that do not blend cleanly with the green background.
issues.suggestion: Use a softer gradient or lower-opacity overlay for the decorative circles so they blend smoothly into the banner.

issues.description: The promotional code text reads "Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10", but the actual code shown in the headline as part of the offer is "TALLINN3" while the headline promise of "3 free deliveries" is not clearly qualified in the visible subtext.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the promo terms (e.g., which orders qualify and how many deliveries remain) so the offer and its conditions are unambiguous.
